title: 12th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/12/2024).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 5/2024 to 8/2024).
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Copyright and Related Rights Act (Law No. 23/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Nilandhoo MP Fathimath Saudha.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes and opened the preliminary debate on the Copyright and Related Rights Act amendment.
